entities.name: Acute leukocyte HSP induction
observations: In 12 athletes running at 75% VO2max, whole-leukocyte HSP27 and inducible HSP70 mRNA/protein increased; induction was greater at 28°C than 18°C, with HSP27 especially heat-sensitive.
In a 6-hour ultramarathon, blood-mononuclear-cell Hsp70 mRNA increased immediately post-race, whereas Hsp27 mRNA did not change.

entities.name: Transient PBMC HSP response
observations: After a first moderate aerobic exercise bout, PBMC HSP70 mRNA rose 1.59-fold and HSP27 mRNA 1.49-fold at 3 hours; protein rose by 24 hours, 3.40-fold for HSP70 and 1.81-fold for HSP27; values returned to basal levels after 5 days of training.

entities.name: Training adaptation of leukocyte HSPs
observations: Ten days of exercise heat acclimation increased basal PBMC HSP72 by 17.7% and HSP90 by 21.1%, but blunted ex-vivo heat-induced HSP72 expression.
Across a year-long handball season, intracellular lymphocyte HSP70 increased in women with normal estradiol, while plasma HSP70 did not change.

entities.name: Context-dependent HSP response
observations: In older adults, acute maximal exercise induced PBMC HSP70 and HSP27 after 12 weeks of explosive resistance training but not in untrained controls; this supports training-dependent priming but is not an endurance protocol.
In chronic-fatigue-syndrome patients, PBMC HSP27 fell immediately after treadmill exercise and remained low at day 1; HSP60 and HSP90 also declined by day 7, unlike controls.
Glutamine supplementation increased PBMC HSP70 before and 2 hours after a 60-minute run at 70% VO2max in 30°C, showing that nutritional and environmental factors modify the response.

entities.name: HSP70
observations: Human endurance exercise studies most consistently report transient leukocyte or PBMC HSP70/HSP72 induction, with earlier mRNA and later protein changes; chronic training can increase basal levels or blunt inducibility.

entities.name: HSP27
observations: Human endurance exercise can increase leukocyte or PBMC HSP27, but the response is less consistent than HSP70 and depends on exercise duration, heat, disease, and sampling time.
